newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia stocks end mixed as rally sputters.
newsitem.headline: Colombia stocks end mixed as rally sputters.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended their broad advance on Thursday, closing mixed with declines in banking and brewing and gains in gasoline distribution and chocolate.
Bogota's IBB index fell 0.49 percent to 1,329.37 on turnover of 4.3 billion pesos, while Medellin's IBOMED general price index rose 0.39 percent to 19,700.59 on turnover of 5.8 billion pesos.
"The market was overheating. It couldn't keep up the rises, and sooner or later there had to be a price correction," a Bogota dealer said.
Colombia's leading brewer Bavaria slipped 0.77 percent to 10,200 in Bogota and dropped 0.88 percent to 10,000 in Medellin.
Banco Ganadero fell 1.91 percent in Bogota to 460, while Banco de Colombia was unchanged at 420.
In Medellin, gasoline distributor Terpel Centro gained 3.13 percent to close at 330, while Compania Nacional de Chocolates rose 2.55 percent to 10,000.
